test_title: PYST 59: SSC CGL 2024 - Reasoning (Held On 13 Sept, 2024 Shift 2)
subject: reasoning
question:
Read the given statements and conclusions carefully. You have to take the given statements to be true if they seem to be at variance from commonly known facts. You have to decide which conclusion(s) logically follow(s) from the given statements.

Statements:

All fruit are sour.

Some sour are vegetables.

Some vegetables are green.

Conclusions:

(i) All vegetables are sour.

(ii) Some sour are green.
solution:
The least possible Venn diagram for the given statements is as shown below :

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/930bf27df587a300a8c3bfd522f2ac03920dee667f271ce426c57de0c2836d49.png] [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/dbe14770b9fbc3978b6b75a33b1bc3a765dd5aaf13b2a33a9780ecc62fa3bf21.png] 

Conclusions:

I. All vegetables are sour → Does not follow (As some sour are vegetables. So it is possible but not definite.)

II. Some sour are green → Does not follow (As All fruit are sour. So it is possible but not definite.)

∴ Here, Neither conclusion (I) nor (II) follows.​

Hence, the correct answer is "Option 2".
